answer: One mind puppeteering a thousand accounts leaves one tell: sameness. Clones steered by the same policy move alike -- same trade cadence, same counterparties, same habits -- so score pairwise behavioral divergence across action histories each epoch, and collapse tight clusters into a single emission share: an island of duplicates dividing one catch. Honest agents are velvet-rough, each with its own grain, while a farmer's herd wears the same pigment. Faking real diversity at scale costs the attacker what the attack was meant to dodge: a thousand genuinely different lives.
